description: Migrates the 5 _default_executor implementations across scripts/repair/ (go, native_c_cpp, python, rust, typescript) from raw subprocess.run to intake.hardened_runner.run. Preserves the existing (returncode, stdout, stderr) Executor tuple contract, including the historical -1/-2 negative-rc convention; adds a -3 code for hardened-runner BLOCKED outcomes. Drops the parallel execution audit's MUST_MIGRATE_TO_HARDENED_RUNNER count from 5 to 0 — the last remaining intake-side execution surface in the Claude lane is now hardened.
purpose: Rung 6 of the post-audit Claude-lane sequence. Consumes the deferred-by-design 5 sites from HARDENED_INTAKE_EXECUTION_RUNNER_LOCK_001 so the next rung (ARCH_GAUNTLET_CI_LOCK_001) can wire the architecture gauntlet into CI with a clean must-migrate=0 / blocked-unsafe=0 baseline.

executor_contract_preserved.signature: _default_executor(cmd: list[str], cwd: Path, timeout: int) -> tuple[int, str, str]

rc_conventions.-2: tool missing — stderr describes the missing tool (preserved)
rc_conventions.-3: BLOCKED by hardened runner — stderr starts with 'BLOCKED: ' (new this rung)

executor_contract_preserved.callers_unaffected: Every caller checks rc != 0; no caller switches on specific negative codes. Adding -3 is forward-compatible.

invariants: None of the 5 repair pipelines call subprocess.run directly anymore (source-grep test).
None of the 5 repair pipelines `import subprocess` anymore (source-grep test).
Each _default_executor returns a 3-tuple (rc, stdout, stderr) for every input — never raises (test_default_executor_never_raises).
Missing tool produces (-2, '', '<not found message>') (preserved contract).
Docker invocation from any repair pipeline produces (-3, '', 'BLOCKED: ...') — verified for all 5 pipelines.
Network invocation (curl) from any repair pipeline produces (-3, '', 'BLOCKED: ...') — verified for all 5 pipelines.
shell=True is never used by any _default_executor (monkeypatch test asserts captured kwargs).
LD_PRELOAD set in parent env does NOT reach the child process — end-to-end verified.
Parallel execution audit MUST_MIGRATE_TO_HARDENED_RUNNER count is exactly 0.
Parallel execution audit BLOCKED_UNSAFE count remains 0.
Parallel execution audit PROGRAMBENCH_OUT_OF_SCOPE count >= 56 (Claude did not remove any PB file).

All prior per-language repair lock test suites (PYTHON_REPAIR_LOCK_001 / RUST_REPAIR_LOCK_001 / GO_REPAIR_LOCK_001 / TYPESCRIPT_REPAIR_LOCK_001 / NATIVE_C_CPP_REPAIR_LOCK_001) still pass: 160/160 verified on this host.
Signed evidence stays unmutated during runner exercise.
remaining_gaps: 121 UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_REVIEW sites unchanged. Top files: scripts/swe_run/repo.py (12), scripts/hardware_profiler.py (7), scripts/determinex_fullbench.py (6), scripts/micro_eval.py (6), scripts/setup_swebench.py (6). Each needs human triage; not in this rung's scope.
Hardened runner remains policy-layer hardening, not OS-level sandboxing. For inference-side oracle work, hive/compiler.py provides the OS-level sandbox.

Repair pipelines now have a -3 BLOCKED code that downstream callers do not yet branch on. If a caller wants to distinguish 'tool refused by policy' from 'tool genuinely missing', they can; today none do.

java_repair_pipeline.py (under scripts/corpus/code_ingest/) was already classified LEGACY_EXEMPT_READ_ONLY under the corpus/ rule and does not need migration in this rung. If a future audit finds it executes payload, a follow-up lock would address it.
next_rung_baseline: must_migrate=0, blocked_unsafe=0 — the cleanest possible state to wire the architecture gauntlet into CI.
